queryPoint.meaning: official highest summit coordinate from the ICGC measurement sheet

officialWmsIdentify.purpose: Official spatial identify at the measurement-sheet summit coordinate; GetFeatureInfo does not supply a feature geometry.

officialReference.identityMethod: Manually matched ICGC summit code and name against the official ICGC list and measurement sheet.

benchmark.pointType: stainless steel geodetic nail fixed in rock

officialReference.verticalReference: Orthometric height, ETRS89/00-EGM08D595, referred to Alicante (Alacant) tide-gauge datum.
officialReference.method: Post-processed GNSS measurement of the benchmark; geoid undulation 53.63 m applied to ellipsoidal height 3196.72 m; geometric levelling measured +0.37 m from benchmark to highest summit point. The official sheet also records the 2010 summit measurement and the 2015 joint GNSS campaign.
officialReference.reviewNote: Thresholds are audit flags, not claims about source accuracy. The official summit coordinate and catalog coordinate do not identify the same point within the configured horizontal tolerance; review the plotted positions before accepting a correction.

acceptance: This probe is not accepted catalog evidence; verify point semantics against the official measurement sheet before any coordinate update.
